The requested kinematics (W = 2.0 GeV, Q² = 3.0 GeV²) cannot be achieved with a 2.2 GeV beam. The beam energy required to satisfy the relation  

\[
E_{\text{beam}} = \frac{W^{2}+Q^{2}-M_{p}^{2}}{2M_{p}} \approx 3.26\ \text{GeV}
\]

exceeds the supplied 2.2 GeV, making the request physically impossible.
